set.body: The current document has one initial analysis chain, Draft.initial refuses saved analyses, and StartDraft rejects unchanged drafts. Introduce persistent nominal analysis-family identity, supported independent creation, revision ownership, navigation, per-family freshness rules and versioned document/journal codecs. Do not infer family identity from revision names or weaken NoChanges to fake creation. Add multi-family immutable saved/reopen and scientific identity tests; wire New analysis and Other analyses in the navigator. Split further into half-day landable slices as needed.
set.title: S7.7b Independent named analysis families and creation
